description: auth-kit upgrades by pull request, for every site made from site-auth-kit-template (auth-kit ADR 0030).
Renovate watches only auth-kit: every other dependency stays with Dependabot or by hand.

Renovate changes only package.json's tarball URL; the site's 'auth-kit upgrade' workflow (.github/workflows/kit-upgrade.yml) writes the lockfile lines with the release's own `auth-kit upgrade`, never `npm install`.
Patch releases that say 'Site steps: none' merge on their own once every check passes; minor and major releases, and any release with site steps, wait for the owner.

customManagers.description: auth-kit's release tarball URL in package.json (Renovate's npm manager skips URL dependencies)

packageRules.description: auth-kit ships as pre-releases (0.1.20-alpha.1), so they count; patch and minor get their own PRs.
prBodyNotes: **How this PR finishes:** Renovate changed only `package.json`. The **auth-kit upgrade** check writes the kit's lockfile lines with this release's own `auth-kit upgrade` (after checking the tarball's attestation), then runs CI on that commit. Its `auth-kit/auto-merge` status is green only for a patch release whose notes say `Site steps: none`; then Renovate squash-merges once every check passes. Anything else waits for the owner: read the release notes below, do the site steps, and merge.

packageRules.description: Patch releases merge on their own, but only once every check is green, including auth-kit/auto-merge.
Minor and major releases always wait for the owner.
